publication: Public reproduction package of the measured 2026-10-08 Scalar3D experiments
exclusion_reason: Earlier 100-epoch script, server authoring script and duplicate previews are not the final 200-epoch surface result. Scientific data from the complete first archive are retained.
corrections_and_reproduction_notes: Layered truth is also used to construct the Gaussian initial model; the historical REPORT closing statement about truth use is too broad.
The original unified runner selects quartile checkpoint indices; use explicit recorded gradient epochs to match the report.
Fixed top two layers means depth grid planes z=0 and z=1, not two geological layers.

required_external_dependency.reason: Required by CUDA training and gradient-recording scripts; absent from both supplied result ZIPs. Use the matching authorized StarWave source checkout. CPU result rendering does not require it.

license_notice: No new overall code or data license is granted by this publication.
